en_title: Fan-Made GTA 5 Port for iPhone Shuts Down After Take-Two Cease and Desist
cn_title: Take-Two发出停止侵权通知后，粉丝自制的iPhone版《GTA 5》移植作品停止运营
opus_summary: Rockstar母公司Take-Two发出停止侵权通知后，粉丝制作的《GTA 5》苹果设备移植项目Five Star Port停止运营。创作者Kevin表示将遵从通知，并警告有人散布声称是「新版本」的副本，可能传播电脑病毒。

paragraphs.en: A cease and desist from Rockstar parent company Take-Two has put an end to a fan-made port of GTA 5 for Apple devices a month after the creator went public with it.
paragraphs.cn: 在创作者公开一款面向苹果设备的粉丝自制《GTA 5》移植作品一个月后，Rockstar母公司Take-Two发出的停止侵权通知令该作品停止运营。

paragraphs.en: Five Star Port launched in October this year as a full native port that ran locally on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. On newer hardware like the A20 Pro chip, the port boasted frame rates between 40 and 60fps at near-native resolution and max graphics settings. It also supported foldable phones, with the controllers and map appearing on the lower portion and the game on the upper portion of the screen.
paragraphs.cn: 《Five Star Port》于今年10月推出，是一款可在iPhone、iPad和Mac上本地运行的完整原生移植作品。在搭载A20 Pro芯片等较新硬件的设备上，该移植作品在接近原生分辨率和最高画质设置下，帧率可达到40至60fps。它还支持折叠屏手机，控制器和地图显示在屏幕下半部分，游戏画面则显示在上半部分。

paragraphs.en: Kevin, the creator of the port, posted a farewell message to the unofficial port’s website . “GTA V has always been one of my favorite games,” he said. “I've made mods for it, worked with FiveM, managed and hosted FiveM servers, and played on plenty of others. It has given me a lot of great memories. Getting to bring it to people who don't have a PC or a console, so they could play it on a phone, has been really, really cool. I honestly never thought this game could run on a phone at all.
paragraphs.cn: 该移植作品的创作者Kevin在这个非官方移植作品的网站上发布了一则告别声明。他说：「《GTA V》一直是我最喜欢的游戏之一。我为它制作过模组，参与过FiveM的工作，管理和托管过FiveM服务器，也在许多其他服务器上玩过。它给了我许多美好的回忆。能够把它带给没有PC或主机的人，让他们可以在手机上玩，真的、真的很酷。说实话，我从未想过这款游戏竟然能在手机上运行。

paragraphs.en: “Take-Two Interactive, through their lawyers, has sent me a cease and desist asking me to stop all activity under the Five Star Port name and everything related to it. I am complying with it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「Take-Two Interactive通过律师向我发出了一份停止侵权通知，要求我停止以《Five Star Port》名义开展的所有活动以及与之相关的一切活动。我正在遵照执行。」

paragraphs.en: Five Star Port’s website, app, and online services were shut down immediately. The Telegram and Discord groups have been made read-only and will be deleted on November 27.
paragraphs.cn: 《Five Star Port》的网站、应用和在线服务立即关闭。Telegram和Discord群组已设为只读，并将于11月27日删除。

paragraphs.en: “I'm not involved in and don't endorse any continuation, rebrand or copy of the port, and I can't help with files or links,” Kevin added. He also posted a warning that scammers have been passing around copies of the port, claiming to have a “new version” of it. These could spread computer viruses.
paragraphs.cn: Kevin补充说：「我没有参与，也不认可该移植作品的任何延续、重新命名或复制版本，我也无法提供文件或链接方面的帮助。」他还发出警告，称骗子一直在传播该移植作品的副本，声称拥有它的「新版本」。这些副本可能传播计算机病毒。

paragraphs.en: “Thank you again to everyone who supported this project: everyone who playtested, everyone who sent suggestions and feedback, and everyone who helped make it a great port that is actually fully playable on an iPhone,” Kevin signed off. “That still feels wild to me.”
paragraphs.cn: Kevin最后写道：「再次感谢所有支持这个项目的人：每一位参与试玩测试的人，每一位提出建议和反馈的人，以及每一位帮助它成为一款出色移植作品的人，让它真的能够在iPhone上完整游玩。直到现在，我仍觉得这不可思议。」

paragraphs.en: Take-Two has a history of forcing fan projects offline, so perhaps it comes as no surprise to see Five Star Port fall by the wayside. The company is currently battling homebrew efforts to vibecode a PC port of GTA 6 , which some believe is mere days away from being playable.
paragraphs.cn: Take-Two过去曾多次迫使粉丝项目下线，因此《Five Star Port》就此终止或许并不令人意外。该公司目前正在对抗一些自制开发者利用「氛围编程」制作《GTA 6》PC移植版的尝试，一些人认为该移植版再过几天就能玩了。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？就在IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过第1章指南与提示、第2章指南与提示以及第3章指南与提示了解开头几个章节的全部细节。如果你已经开车四处游历Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
